  • 內容簡介

    The Cut 是 Ellery 的招牌英文單口喜劇秀，每一場都會持續進化，內容只包含最新、最精彩的段子。隨著一小時專場的逐漸成形，只有最荒謬、最gay、以及最黑暗的笑話，才能留在 The Cut。 當晚還有 Ellery 最受歡迎的角色「德州阿姨」特別登場。德州阿姨的演出完全依靠現場即興互動，因此每一場都獨一無二。想增加被阿姨點名互動的機會，記得搶 VIP 前排座位。 Ellery presents THE CUT | Fall Edition The Cut is Ellery’s flagship English language comedy show, an ever-evolving showcase of his newest and best material. As he continues building his first full hour, only the silliest, gayest, and darkest jokes make the cut. The night also features a special appearance by Tammy Jo, Ellery’s beloved Texas auntie. Tammy’s segment is entirely improvised crowd work, meaning no two shows are ever the same. Want to improve your chances of interacting with Tammy?
